facts.fact_text: The disciplinary sanction of a warning was imposed on the applicant pursuant to section 125 of the Civil Servants Act (Law no. 657).
A full description of the relevant domestic law at the material time can be found in Karaçay v. Turkey (no. 6615/03, §§ 14-17, 27 March 2007).
